story.title: The Interviews
story.blurb: Non-canon. Emmett and Josephine, perhaps the last two Squoatlings, are hounded across Daerthlorn by news crews whose questions get more personal every time.

lines.text: It took Daerthlorn five months until the news crews realized who their newest residents were. Oh, the publicity their channels could receive with the event of a Squoatling couple living on their planet. Some time passed for the Channel Five crew to find the man, but as soon as they caught track of Emmett's whereabouts, it wasn't long until they found him.
"Oh hi! You're a Squoatling!" Emmett looked from side to side while in his Vegetation Co. uniform.

lines.text: After Channel Five broadcasted the short interview, the other crews were infuriated. More and more interviews were made, with some lasting all night. Both Emmett and Josephine were exhausted. They went into positions where they knew they would not be interviewed. On the contrary, the crews caught up, and started to break barriers to reach them. Channel Six, in particular, actually broke into their apartment.
"Josephine! We have some questions!" A buff security guard kicked down the bathroom door. Josephine, who had just finished showering, pulled the shower curtain over herself to cover her shame.
